notes.title: "Revengeful Ghost" ver.1.0.2 has been released.
notes.notes: [p]<"Revengeful Ghost" ver.1.0.2 Bug Fixes>[/p][p]- Fixed a phenomenon in which the player's body floats when running down the stairs of the school building.[/p]

notes.title: "Revengeful Ghost" ver.1.0.1 has been released.
notes.notes: [p]<"Revengeful Ghost" ver.1.0.1 Bug Fixes>[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor would remain visible after returning to the game when the settings screen was opened during the game.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where menu text other than the selected item would remain when opening the settings screen during the game and selecting each item.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where sounds were not categorized as either BGM or SE.[/p][p]*Please note that the sound of the train running cannot be adjusted (muted) as a specification.[/p]
